content: Though this approach has achieved good empirical results, we argue that it suffers from two major limitations. Firstly, models that use beam search to generate multiple keyphrases generally lack the ability to determine the dynamic number of keyphrases needed for different source texts. Meanwhile, the parallelism in beam search also fails to model the inter-relation among the generated phrases, which can often result in diminished diversity in the output. Although certain existing models take output diversity into consideration during training BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 , the effort is significantly undermined during decoding due to the reliance on over-generation and phrase ranking with beam search.
